photos.title: The Veil Speaks
photos.desc: Something unseen presses forward. The veil is not a barrier — it is a message.

photos.title: Consumed by Shadow
photos.desc: When the dark does not threaten but absorbs. A self dissolving into something larger.

photos.title: Before I Disappeared
photos.desc: The last moment of being fully visible. Everything after is a kind of fading.

photos.title: Searching for Signs
photos.desc: Eyes open, looking inward. The signs were always there.

photos.title: Unraveling in Colour
photos.desc: Coming apart is not always quiet. Sometimes it is vivid.

photos.title: Covered in Gold
photos.desc: To be gilded is not to be whole. But there is beauty in the covering.

photos.title: Still in the Glow
photos.desc: Bathed in something warm and unearned. Stillness as its own kind of grace.

photos.title: The Joy That Holds
photos.desc: Not the joy that erupts. The joy that stays — quiet, steady, unexplained.

photos.title: The Space Between
photos.desc: Neither here nor there. The gap is where most of living happens.

photos.title: No More Than a Shadow
photos.desc: Reduced to outline. What remains when everything else is stripped away.

photos.title: She Burns Bright
photos.desc: Not burning out. Burning forward. The kind of light that does not ask permission.

photos.title: Of Gold and Gravity
photos.desc: Heavy and luminous at once. To carry gold is still to carry weight.

photos.title: Before the Words Come
photos.desc: The moment just before language arrives. Pure feeling, unmediated.

photos.title: Blood and Shadow
photos.desc: The series ends where it began — in the body, in the dark, in the self.
